correctness.rationale: For every SPD A, 1<=m<=d-2 and consecutive nonzero Lanczos coefficients, R_m has rank \(d-m\) by the exact Gaussian-conditioning congruence. The approximation splits into the orthogonal two-plane K and scalar bulk; the strict spectral-moment Cauchy--Schwarz inequality \(p_1p_3>p_2^2\) follows from beta_{m+1}>0, and omega>0. Hence rank K=2, total rank \(d-m+1\). Exact rational calculations give the displayed 3-by-3 covariance, determinant 1/100, variance 4/25 in an exactly observed direction, and a parameter family with continuous zero-norm error limit. CHECK.py reconstructed and verified each certificate from its actual package path; finite checks are not used as a universal proof.

value.rationale: Exact linear observations remove one Gaussian uncertainty direction each, and the source motivates its approximation for numerical uncertainty quantification. Generically adding one spurious eigenvalue changes exact nullspace calibration and yields mutually singular computational posteriors with infinite KL in either direction; the effect persists as the operator error tends to zero. An all-dimension rank law, a minimal exact-rational example with positive measured-direction variance, and a robust one-parameter family make this a structural fidelity boundary rather than a simple single-entry arithmetic check.
